description.value: You've trained to be part of the army of engineers required to keep the massive desalination rigs of Dorjo operational, or to work on one of the thousand other interconnected systems your people depend upon. You become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Quick Repair feat.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
